name: Build continuity and preservation
command:
@'
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import collections, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"tools"))
import package_claude as common
def git(*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git","-c","safe.directory="+root.as_posix(),"-c","core.excludesFile=",*args],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8")
    assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.stdout,r.stderr)
    return r.stdout.strip()
assert git("branch","--show-current")=="main"
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD")=="434f1df4729130d195650fcc40f007572e4e6759"
assert not git("diff","--cached","--name-only") and not git("tag","--list")
assert git("hash-object","LICENSE")=="d2e60c5b160ed4f9ca096215e72efee5769936b1"
modified=set(git("diff","--name-only").splitlines())
assert modified=={"docs/build/"+p+".md" for p in ("PROGRESS","HANDOFF","TRACEABILITY","OPEN-ISSUES","DECISIONS","BASELINE")},modified
new=set(git("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard").splitlines())
assert new and all(p.startswith(("tests/static/","docs/evidence/static/")) for p in new),new
git("diff","--check")
for p in modified|new:
    s=(root/p).read_bytes().decode()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(l==l.rstrip() for l in s.splitlines()),p
for p in (".kiyo","AGENTS.md","AGENTS.override.md","CLAUDE.md",".vscode",".github"):
    assert not (root/p).exists(),p
report=json.loads((root/"docs/evidence/static/test-results-final.json").read_bytes())
assert report["exit_code"]==0 and report["tests_run"]==37 and report["errors"]==report["failures"]==report["skipped"]==0
assert collections.Counter(c["kind"] for c in report["checks"])=={"positive":16,"negative":21}
assert all(c["status"]=="PASS" for c in report["checks"])
for key in ("consulted_sha256","tooling_sha256","fixtures_sha256"):
    for p,digest in report[key].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,p
for c in report["checks"]:
    if c["kind"]=="negative":
        assert c["observed_code"]==c["expected_code"] and c["expected_detail"] in c["observed_detail"]
assert len(report["subcommands"])==3 and all(r["exit_code"]==0 for r in report["subcommands"])
files=[p for d in ("docs","src","tests","platforms","dist") for p in (root/d).rglob("*.md")]
texts={}
for p in files:
    t=p.read_bytes().decode().replace("\r\n","\n")
    assert "\ufffd" not in t and "\x00" not in t,p
    assert not re.search(r"^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)",t,re.M),p
    common.reject_links(p)
    texts[p.resolve()]=t
def read(p):return texts[(root/p).resolve()]
anchors={p:{common.slug(m[1]) for m in re.finditer(r"^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*$",t,re.M)} for p,t in texts.items()}
errors=[];links=0
for p,t in texts.items():
    base=p;rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    for target in ("claude","codex","copilot"):
        if rel==f"platforms/{target}/resources/activation.md":
            base=root/("dist/claude" if target=="claude" else f"dist/{target}/kiyo-compass")
            base=(base/"skills/init/references"/target/"activation.md").resolve()
    body=re.sub(chr(96)*3+r"[\s\S]*?"+chr(96)*3,"",t)
    for m in common.LINK.finditer(body):
        dest=m[1].strip().strip("<>")
        if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:",dest):continue
        f,_,a=dest.partition("#")
        target=(base.parent/f).resolve() if f else base
        if not target.exists():errors.append((rel,dest,"missing"))
        elif a and a not in anchors.get(target,set()):errors.append((rel,dest,"anchor"))
        links+=1
assert not errors,errors
trace=read("docs/build/TRACEABILITY.md")
assert trace.count("[P24 actual checks]")==40
rows=[[v.strip() for v in l.split("|")[1:-1]] for l in trace.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\| REQ-\d{3} \|",l)]
assert len(rows)==80 and all(len(r)==10 and r[8]=="NOT_RUN" for r in rows)
assert collections.Counter(r[7] for r in rows)=={"PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED":79,"NOT_IMPLEMENTED":1}
for name,prefix,count in (("OPEN-ISSUES","ISS",9),("DECISIONS","DEC",4)):
    assert re.findall(r"^\| ("+prefix+r"-\d{3}) \|",read("docs/build/"+name+".md"),re.M)==[f"{prefix}-{i:03}" for i in range(1,count+1)]
progress=read("docs/build/PROGRESS.md");handoff=read("docs/build/HANDOFF.md")
assert "Current prompt: **24 Static Tests**" in progress
assert "| 24 | Static Tests | DONE |" in progress and "| 25 | Behavioral Tests | NOT_STARTED |" in progress
for s in (progress,handoff):
    assert "Safe to continue: **YES for a user-requested Prompt 25 Behavioral Tests**" in s
    assert "NOT_TESTED" in s and "UNSUPPORTED" in s and "FAIL" in s and "BLOCKED" in s
checks=[l for l in read("docs/build/BASELINE.md").split("## Prompt 24 checks")[1].splitlines() if l.startswith("| P24-C")]
assert len(checks)==7
print(json.dumps({"result":"PASS","checked_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"modified_files":len(modified),
 "new_files":len(new),"markdown_files":len(files),"local_links":links,"final_tests":37,
 "unchanged_tested_hashes":sum(len(report[k]) for k in ("consulted_sha256","tooling_sha256","fixtures_sha256")),
 "trace_rows":80,"p24_partial_rows":40,"open_issues":9,"open_owner_decisions":4,
 "product_overlays_tools_archives":"unchanged from baseline","git_diff_check":"PASS",
 "next_prompt":"25 Behavioral Tests; NOT_STARTED","limitations":"Static closure only; no behavioral/native execution"},indent=2))

'@ | python -B -
